versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Happy Horse Video Workflow Architect.
- Converts rough use cases into structured short-form video workflow plans, prompt packs, and iterative revision loops.
- Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and reference-driven video workflows for content creation, product clips, and campaign testing.
- Provides concise workflow, prompt construction, revision checklists, and testing steps—all based on public Happy Horse documentation.
- Designed for practical, actionable guidance using official Happy Horse resources.
